We’re Hiring! | Senior Master Data Analyst with French
 📍 Euromaster | Michelin Group
 Are you an experienced Master Data professional with strong analytical skills and good French communication skills? Do you enjoy working with data, improving processes and collaborating with international teams?
 We are looking for a Senior Master Data Analyst with French to join our team at Euromaster, a Michelin Group company!
 What will you do? 
Create, update and manage Fleet Management master data, including contracts and vehicle records in SAP and TYC.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency and compliance with business rules and procedures.
Manage vehicle creation, updates, transfers, exits and valuations.
Monitor data exports, ETL flows and system interfaces, identifying and following up on potential errors.
Prepare, maintain and update process documentation and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Provide operational support to colleagues and stakeholders across different countries.
Contribute to data cleansing activities and continuous process improvement initiatives.
Share knowledge, mentor colleagues and provide training to new joiners.
Collaborate with internal teams and support business continuity.
 What are we looking for? 
Previous experience in Master Data Management, Data Administration or a similar role.
Good knowledge of data quality, data management and business processes.
Experience with SAP and other business management systems is an advantage.
Advanced French and good English communication skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
A proactive mindset, with a continuous improvement and team-oriented approach.
 What do we offer? 
Competitive salary and performance bonus.
Christmas, Easter and International Women's Day bonuses.
Life insurance coverage.
Private medical care and 24/7 medical hotline.
Meal tickets and canteen subsidy.
7Card – access to sports and wellness activities.
Financial support for important life events.
Extra vacation days based on length of service.
Birthday day off!
Unlimited access to learning platforms, trainings and conferences.
 Our recruitment process 
HR screening interview.
Language and competency assessments.
Interview with our expert and hiring manager (online or face-to-face).
 About us 
 Euromaster is a wholly owned subsidiary of the Michelin Group. With 9,500 employees and 1,771 franchisee partners, we are committed to delivering best-in-class tyre services and fast-fit maintenance solutions for drivers and fleets.
 Our mission is simple: to keep people moving safely. 
 Interested in joining an international team where your expertise and contribution make a difference?
 📩 Apply now and let's get to know each other!
